summary: Market still heavy into Nvidia's report after the close, with losses picking up through the afternoon and Home Depot leading the Dow lower, so the put side holds. Since 11:35: no change; quote pages unavailable, prices are estimates.

picks.name: Home Depot
picks.reason: Q3 beat but traffic fell, holiday-quarter guide light and CEO Decker hands off to CFO McPhail; a top Dow drag as the index sheds ~870 pts; under 336 extends, reclaiming ~346 fails.

picks.name: Intel
picks.reason: Down ~2.6% premarket near 54 after Nvidia's 13F showed a 25% stake cut, on top of Monday's 7% drop and a shareholder suit; under 53 extends, back over Monday's ~55.5 close fails.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq-100 extending losses as the S&P drops ~1.3% midday and chips sell off into Nvidia's report, after Monday's 2.5% drop and new chip export controls; under 654 extends, over 665 negates.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down more than 3% under the 153 breakdown and dragging the market into the red ahead of tonight's report (options price ~8.5% move); under 149.5 extends toward 146, back over 154 negates.

picks.name: Walt Disney
picks.reason: FQ4 beat, dividend up 33% to $2, $9B buyback, but the early pop faded to about -1%; needs to reclaim 123 to trend, under 118.5 fails.

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: GTA VI launches Thursday with presales ahead of forecasts and Jefferies at $300, but Monday's gap faded; a push through the ~237.4 high extends, under 228 fails (price is an estimate).
